subject.title: Gateway silently skips channel initialization on plugin/runtime mismatch or missing module files

question: What startup contract should Gateway use when a configured channel plugin fails before channel registration?
rationale: Current main logs plugin-level failures but only starts already-loaded channel plugins; choosing fail-fast, warn-and-audit, or status-only behavior affects upgrade compatibility and operator expectations.

options.title: Warn and audit configured channels
options.body: Add a structured startup audit for configured channel attempts, successes, and pre-registration failures while keeping the Gateway alive and splitting hot reload/performance work out.

options.title: Fail fast for configured mismatches
options.body: Stop Gateway startup when a configured channel plugin is incompatible or missing required runtime files, trading clearer failure for higher upgrade breakage risk.

options.title: Keep plugin-only diagnostics
options.body: Treat current plugin diagnostics plus narrower issues as sufficient and leave channel-level startup audit out of core for now.

recommendation.title: Warn and audit configured channels
recommendation.body: Add a structured startup audit for configured channel attempts, successes, and pre-registration failures while keeping the Gateway alive and splitting hot reload/performance work out.

likelyOwner.reason: The current channel startup and plugin-loader diagnostic lines are carried by Vincent Koc in local blame, making this the best available routing signal for the startup-contract decision.
